sentences.text: Daniel `` Dan '' Martin -LRB- born 20 August 1986 -RRB- is an Irish professional road racing cyclist who rides for UCI ProTeam .	road racing cyclist	road racing cyclist	UCI ProTeam	UCI ProTeam
Born and raised in England , Martin has competed for Ireland since 2006 .

Martin 's accomplishments since turning professional in 2008 include winning a stage at the 2011 Vuelta a España , winning a stage at the 2013 Tour de France , and winning the overall classification at the 2010 Tour de Pologne and the 2013 Volta a Catalunya .
